Welcome to the official Youtube channel of Frontenac Chiropractic and Sports Rehab. We are a multidisciplinary clinic located in Kingston, Ontario, Canada, integrating chiropractic care, sports rehabilitation, and contemporary medical acupuncture to improve function and performance.

Our channel is designed to provide evidence based education and rehabilitation exercises to patients and athletes to aid in the recovery of various musculoskeletal conditions. 

Disclaimer: The video content of this channel is for informational purposes only and does not constitute medical advice, nor is it intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Please consult the advice of a physician or qualified health provider regarding any medical advice or medical condition.
